basic.name: Queen's Curse
basic.description: After 1 second, turn enemy Heroes in an area into Shamblers for 3 seconds, making them unable to attack, use Abilities, and slowing them by 30%.

basic.name: Overgrowth
basic.description: Spawn an Overgrowth that disables nearby Structures. You deal 200% bonus damage to Structures affected by Overgrowth. Slowly loses Health over 25 seconds.

basic.name: Sprint
basic.description: Increase Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.
